tools.name: check
tools.description: Simulate one hypothetical character action without changing actual game state. For a hypothetical sequence, carry simulated changes forward within that sequence. A check does not authorize execution.

instrument.description: Named instrument, or the literal string none when the character acts without a separate instrument.

target.description: Target of the action; resolve pronouns from the query.

query: I close the treasure chamber door. Could I lift the golden tray with the crowbar and then carry it to the table?
reasoning:
'close the treasure chamber door' -> action 'close', target 'treasure chamber door', instrument 'none' -> (instrument:action:target) none:close:treasure chamber door
'lift the golden tray with the crowbar' -> action 'lift', target 'golden tray', instrument 'crowbar' -> (instrument:action:target) crowbar:lift:golden tray
[and then]
'carry it to the table' -> 'it' refers to 'golden tray' -> action 'carry to table', target 'golden tray', instrument 'none' -> (instrument:action:target) none:carry to table:golden tray
'I close' -> committed action -> enter_command
'Could I' -> feasibility question -> check
none:close:treasure chamber door [before] crowbar:lift:golden tray [before] none:carry to table:golden tray
none:close:treasure chamber door -> crowbar:lift:golden tray -> none:carry to table:golden tray
